context: This evaluation assesses how well the engineer uses the @modelcontextprotocol/sdk and babel-plugin-react-compiler packages to build an MCP tool that exposes React Compiler functionality with pipeline introspection.

checklist.name: McpServer initialization
checklist.description: Uses McpServer class from @modelcontextprotocol/sdk to create a server instance with name and version metadata

checklist.name: Tool registration
checklist.description: Uses server.tool() method to register a compilation tool with appropriate name, description, and Zod schema for input validation

checklist.name: Zod schema definition
checklist.description: Defines tool input schema using z.string() for code text and z.enum() or z.optional() for passName parameter with correct enum values ('HIR', 'ReactiveFunction')

checklist.name: Babel parseAsync usage
checklist.description: Uses parseAsync from @babel/core with appropriate parserOpts including 'typescript' and 'jsx' plugins to parse React component code

checklist.name: Compiler plugin integration
checklist.description: Uses BabelPluginReactCompiler from babel-plugin-react-compiler with transformFromAstAsync to compile the parsed AST

checklist.name: Pipeline logging
checklist.description: Configures PluginOptions with logger.debugLogIRs callback to capture CompilerPipelineValue objects during compilation

checklist.name: IR printing functions
checklist.description: Uses printFunctionWithOutlined() for HIR and printReactiveFunctionWithOutlined() for ReactiveFunction to extract intermediate representations based on passName

checklist.name: Diagnostic extraction
checklist.description: Captures compilation diagnostics by handling CompileError events in logger.logEvent callback and extracting error messages with source locations
